user_prompt: We need to verify that our current component sourcing meets all regulatory requirements while simultaneously checking our real-time inventory levels to ensure we have adequate stock from our qualified suppliers before we proceed with the next production run.

steps.step_name: Verify that our current component sourcing meets all regulatory requirements

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt/shipment recording), Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents, VendorMaterialProcurementCoordinator agent (AGENT ONLY)
- sap.ehs: Safety/health agents - SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator, IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer (analyzes incidents/trends), IncidentResponseCoordinator, ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (READ/monitor vendor + PO data)
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (NO create API)
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator, SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator, HazmatIncidentComplianceMonitor
- siemens.plm: PLM - EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, BOMComplianceValidator, SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator, QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

SAFETY INCIDENT ANALYSIS:
sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - BEST FOR INCIDENT ANALYSIS & TRENDS:
  • Autonomously analyzes safety incidents to identify root causes
  • Analyzes incident data, environmental factors, and historical patterns
  • Generates structured root cause analysis reports with corrective/preventive actions
  • Prioritizes actions by risk severity and regulatory impact
  • Related entity types: SafetyIncident, Incident, HazardousSubstance
  • Tags: incident-analysis, root-cause, automation, corrective-action

REGULATORY COMPLIANCE VERIFICATION - COMPONENT SOURCING:
siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 - BEST FOR VERIFYING COMPONENT SOURCING COMPLIANCE:
  • Validates BOMs against regulatory standards & restricted substance directives
  • Verifies supplier qualification requirements
  • Flags non-compliant materials/components, recommends approved substitutes
  • Generates compliance documentation
  • Capability: verify-component-standards, validate-bom-compliance, assess-material-compliance
  • Tags: compliance, bom-validation, supplier-qualification
  • Alternative: my.mes:agent:BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator:v1 (more manufacturing execution focused)

args.reason: This agent autonomously validates bill of materials against regulatory standards, restricted substance directives, and supplier qualifications—directly verifying that sourced components meet all regulatory requirements.

method_trace.picked_reason: This agent autonomously validates bill of materials against regulatory standards, restricted substance directives, and supplier qualifications—directly verifying that sourced components meet all regulatory requirements.

REAL-TIME INVENTORY/STOCK MONITORING:
sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 - BEST FOR REAL-TIME INVENTORY FROM QUALIFIED SUPPLIERS:
  • REST API for creating, updating, AND MONITORING purchase orders across supplier networks
  • Real-time status tracking of POs
  • Exposes Vendor + PurchaseOrder entity types
  • Capabilities: coordinate-vendor-procurement, validate-purchase-orders, verify-vendor-compliance
  • Procurement teams confirm vendors can supply materials meeting compliance requirements before issuing POs
  • Vendor management validates suppliers maintain certification for regulated materials
  • Direct successor to BOMComplianceValidator workflow (vendor qualification verified upstream)
